verdict.rationale: Sentry's alerts documentation states directly that an alert rule can call webhooks, alongside notifications and tickets, for issues from projects or Monitors. That gives a programmatic consumer an outbound HTTP trigger for automated remediation or agents. Separately, Seer can launch Cursor Cloud Agents and run Autofix to create PRs, a first-party path to agent-driven remediation. Missing for 10: documentation of webhook registration, payload schema and request signing, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents

citations.quote: An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations for issues coming from projects or Monitors.
Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules.
Launch Cursor Cloud Agents from Seer.
